name: brake-death-holder
note: Ideas 61/71, CMD-08 + REL-01/REL-05: the holder dies IN THE MIDDLE of the braking ramp (tick 500, 0.45 s before the ramp ends). The question the study answers: is the braking interrupted by the handover? At level C the certified second substitutes (REL-05); at level S the will of the last order covers the handover (ACT-02) and B is granted within three periods (REL-01). Measure the deviation to the deceleration setpoint against the twin.
